The UK species blue tit and great tit are pictured in Sweden. Crop coordinates are review inputs, not alterations to the stored original.

dog.jpg: PyTorch Hub example image, retrieved from https://github.com/pytorch/hub/blob/master/images/dog.jpg solely for local nonbird evaluation. Upstream repository BSD3 license; image-specific attribution unspecified. Do not redistribute as product artwork.

Audio regression uses upstream tests/testdata/Pica pica_30s.wav and upstream CC BY-NC-SA license. It is mounted at /fixtures during Docker tests, not duplicated.

https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The quality probe darkens the robin to 15% brightness and places a 112 × 94 robin thumbnail into a 1500 × 1200 plain background in memory. These are synthetic difficulty cases; they do not establish performance on real night or distant photography. Generated variants retain the robin's CC BY-SA 2.5 terms.
